PLDMFirmwareComponent.description: A single PLDM T5 firmware component on a PLDMFirmwareDevice. pldmd matches it against the device's GetFirmwareParameters response by ComponentIdentifier.

Name.description: The component's human-visible identifier. Becomes the suffix of /xyz/openbmc_project/software/<Name> when pldmd creates the Software.Version object.

ComponentIdentifier.description: Per DSP0267 section 10.1; matched against the ComponentIdentifier field in the device's PLDM T5 GetFirmwareParameters response.

Manufacturer.description: If set, pldmd writes the value to the resulting Software.Version object's xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Decorator.Asset.Manufacturer property.

AssociationForward.description: Per-component association forward types, one per association. Index-aligned with AssociationBackward/AssociationEndpoint. pldmd zips the three arrays into the Software.Version object's Association.Definitions interface; surfaces as Redfish RelatedItem. Flat string arrays are used (rather than a nested object array) so the association survives entity-manager's PlatformExposes flattening onto the Components<N> child interface.

AssociationBackward.description: Per-component association backward (reverse) types, index-aligned with AssociationForward/AssociationEndpoint.

AssociationEndpoint.description: Per-component association endpoint object paths, index-aligned with AssociationForward/AssociationBackward.

PLDMAssociation.description: A forward/backward/path association tuple consumed by pldmd or entity-manager.

PLDMFirmwareDevice.description: Downstream Exposes type. One entry per PLDM T5 firmware-update target. Presence tells pldmd the device is a PLDM firmware-update target; the nested Components array carries every firmware component on the device.

Name.description: A recognisable name for the PLDMFirmwareDevice entry.

MCTPTargetName.description: Match key tying this entry to the transport anchor's Name (MCTPUSBDevice/MCTPI2CTarget/MCTPSPIDevice.Name for direct devices, or MCTPBridgePoolDevice.Name for bridged devices).

Components.description: The list of firmware components on this device. Encoded on D-Bus as aa{sv}. Order is not load-bearing; pldmd matches by ComponentIdentifier.

StaticEID.description: Temporary workaround: static MCTP EID pldmd uses to associate this entry to an endpoint while configured_by is not yet reliably published. Removed once dynamic configured_by resolution works end-to-end.

title: PLDM Firmware Device Exposes Record
